<script>
// A push that never stops, and the dust that never settles.
tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1.02 }, { scale: 1.12, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
  tl.fromTo("#m" + i, { y: 0, x: 0 }, { y: -180 - rand(i) * 260, x: (rand(i + 50) - .5) * 90, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
}
tl.fromTo("#far", { x: 40 }, { x: -60, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#lamp0", { opacity: .6 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.out" }, 0);

// Six hours: the sand drains, slowly, heavily.
tl.fromTo("#glass", { opacity: 0, y: 60 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: .9, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#glass", { rotation: -1.5, svgOrigin: "540 960" }, { rotation: 1.5, duration: 2.8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#topSand", { scaleY: 1, svgOrigin: "540 560" }, { scaleY: .12, duration: 2.4, ease: "power1.inOut" }, .3);
tl.fromTo("#pile", { scaleY: .08, svgOrigin: "540 926" }, { scaleY: 1, duration: 2.4, ease: "power1.inOut" }, .3);
tl.fromTo("#stream", { scaleY: 0, svgOrigin: "540 560" }, { scaleY: 1, duration: .3, ease: "power2.in" }, .3);

// "versus": the camera crosses the room to the stopwatch.
const vs = at("versus", 2.6);
tl.to("#strip", { x: -1080, duration: .65, ease: "power3.inOut" }, vs - .2);
tl.to("#far", { x: -260, duration: .65, ease: "power3.inOut" }, vs - .2);
tl.to("#dust", { x: -120, duration: .65, ease: "power3.inOut" }, vs - .2);
tl.fromTo("#watch", { scale: .86, svgOrigin: "1620 600" }, { scale: 1, duration: .8, ease: "expo.out" }, vs + .1);

// "four minutes now": a click, one fast sweep, done — and the light catches it.
const four = at("four", 3.1);
tl.to("#crown", { y: 12, duration: .07, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.in" }, four - .12);
tl.fromTo("#hand", { rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "1620 600" }, { rotation: 360, duration: .75, ease: "power3.inOut" }, four);
tl.to("#arc", { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: .75, ease: "power3.inOut" }, four);
tl.fromTo("#glint", { x: -420 }, { x: 520, duration: .55, ease: "power2.inOut" }, four + .75);
tl.to("#lamp1", { opacity: 1.2, scale: 1.08, duration: .4, ease: "power2.out" }, four + .7);
</script>
